definitions.full: H745. Aryeh אַרְיֵה proper name, masculine so apparently 2Kin 15:25 an officer of Pekahiah, but with article הָאַרְיֵה , & on text with possible corruption & dittography see Klo.

occurrences.englishText: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.
